name: Sensitive example encounter prescription discharge summary
notes:
This report shows the total quantity of medication selected for discharge for each of the selected drugs (all drugs when none are selected) within a specified date range, based on what clinicians recorded at discharge rather than pharmacy dispensing records. For deployments that record dispensing via the pharmacy dispensing module instead, use the 'Medication dispensed summary' report.

This version covers facilities in the 'example' sensitive network only.
